content: Jesus walu-yinduman.
Warngku 6-balaman, Jesusangka Peter, James, John wundin manjalba. James bula John yaba-yabaju. Jana janarrku manjalba jarra-jarranga dakarin.
Yinyaymba Jesus nyulu walu-yindumanijin. Nyulu walu dayirrman, balbal-balban yala wungarabu. Nyungu kambi bingajimanijin, dayirr bajaku yala light.
Bula Moses, Elijah, bula ngadimunku. Bula nguymal milbijin, Jesusanji balkawan. Jana disciplesangka jananin nyajin.
Peterangka Jesusanda yalaman, “Maja, yinya ngulkurr ngana muruman yalaymba. Yundu wawu ngayu bayan kulur ngaranka? Nyubun bayan yunuku, nyubun Mosesamu, nyubun Elijahmu.”

Nyulu Peter balkan-balkawanku, ngurrban dayirr wuyar kadan jananda. Jana kuku nyajin ngurrbanmun yalamanya, “Yanyu ngayku kangkal, ngayu nyungunku wawu jirray, wawurr-wawurrmanijin nyungunku. Yurra nyungundu milka-janay.”
Jana jawun-karrangka yinya kuku nyajin, kungkurr-kadarin, bubungu dararin, yinyilmarinya.
Yamba Jesus jananda kadan, marabu karrban, yalaman, “Janarikada, kari yinyilmarikada.”
Jana miyil walnganda, Jesusku nyajin. Bula Moses, Elijah nguymal kariman.

Yinyamun jana bada manjalmundurr kankadan, Jesusangka jananda yalaman, “Yurra bamanda kari balka yurra yinya nyajin. Ngayu bamanga wubulbuku yaba. Juma ngayu yarkinmun juranmal baja. Wawu yinyamun yurra balkada.”
Jana Jesusanda babajin, “Jana teacher-teacher ngadimunku, jana wanyurrinku balkal Elijahngarr jakalba kadanka, Christ kudamundu?”
Nyulu yalaman, “Yuwu, nyulu Elijahngarr kadanda. Nyulu kadan, bama yanday-bunganka junkayku bundanka.

Ngayu yurranda manubajabuku balkal, nyulu bama yala Elijah kadanda. Yamba bamangka nyungun kari nyungun-bungan. Jana nyungunin buyun-daman, yarkinkaku kunin. Ngayu bamanga wubulbuku yaba. Jana nganya yalarrku buyun-damalkuda.”
Jawun-karrangka yinya kuku nyajin, binalmanda, nyulu balkal-balkan John the Baptistanka. John kadan yala Elijahnguy.
Jesusangka dubu kangan warrundumun.
Yinyamun jana Jesus manjalmun kadarin, bamanda wubulbuku. Nyubun dingkar Jesusanda kadan, bungkubu janan,
yalaman, “Maja, manun-manunmaka ngaykuwunku kangkalka dingkaranka. Dubu dukurrbu walan. Nyulu dubungku ngayku kangkal buyun-damal-damal, kangkal yaran-yararri, darayda, bayanga, bananga.
Ngayu nyungunin wundin yunuwunbu jawun-karranda, yamba jana dubu can't kangan.”

Jesusangka jananda bamanda yalaman, “Yurra wubulku bundandayda, yurra nganya warmbil-warmbil, kari junkayku bundanday. Ngayu ngadingka bundandan yurranji. Yurra wanja-wanja nganya kuku nyajil? Karrkay ngaykundu wundi.”
Jesusangka dubu murru-kangan, karrkayandamun kangan. Nyulu Dubu wandin karrkayandamun. Nyulu karrkay jinbalku ngulkurrmanda.
Yinyamun jana jawun-karra 12-bala janarrku Jesusanda kadarin. Jana babajin, “Nganjin can't dubu kangan. Wanyurrinku nyulu kari dungan?”

Jesusangka yalaman, “Yurra nganya warmbil-warmbin, kuku buban nyajin. Yinyaynka yurra nyungun kari kangan. Ngayu yurranda balkal, kaki yurra nganya bubanku kuku nyajil, and kari warmbil, yurra balkal yinya manjal jurrkijinka yalamun yinyaymba. Yinya manjal jurrkijikuda. Yurra babaji, Godungku dajilkuda. Yurra nganya kuku nyajil, yurra junkurr manilda, junjuy-junjuy wubulku balkanka.
Kaki yurra dubu yalanguy kanganka, yurra mayi kariku nuka, Godunji balkawanka. Yinyamun dubu kangakuda.”
Jesusangka balkan baja nyulu juma wulay.
Jana jawun-karra murumarin bubungu Galilee, Jesusangka jananda yalaman, “Ngayu wubulbuku yaba. Jana nganya mambarril dingkar-dingkaranda, kuninka.
Jana nganya yarkinkaku kunil. Warngku kulurmal, ngayu juranmal baja.” Jana jawun-karra milka-bujarmanyarrkuda yinyaynka kukuku.
Kuku moneyka taxmunku.

Wawu yinyamun jana Jesus townbu Capernaum kadarin. Yinyaymba kanbal dingkar-dingkar Peteranda kadarin. Jana dingkar-dingkarangka tax money mujan Jew-warrandamunku churchmunku. Jana Peteranda babajin, “Yunuwundu majangka tax money payim-bungal Jew-warrandamunku churchmunku?”

Peterangka yalaman, “Yuwu, payim-bungalkuda.” Nyulu Peter bayanbaku kadan baja, Jesusangka nyungundu yalaman, “Simon, yundu wanyu milkabu baykal? Jana maja-maja king, jana wanjundumun tax money bangkal? Jawun-karrandamun or bamandamun yindu-yindundumun?”
Peterangka yalaman, “Bamandamun yindu-yindundumun.” Jesusangka yalamanda, “Yuwu, kingandamundu jawun-karrangka tax money kari payim-bungal.

Yamba ngali jananin wawu kari kuli-kanganka. Yundu bada beachmunbu dungayda, badur yilbada. Kuyungku baykal, yundu kulbada. Yundu ngandalba money warrmba-bungal. Mana, jananda dayada ngalinga tax money churchmunku.”
